'''Graff Teiras''' was an [[Agent/Legends|agent]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was stationed in [[Callia's]] aboard the ''[[Cal Ambre]]'', serving as chief lieutenant for [[Retter Lewis]]' pipeline for transporting defecting [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Officer/Legends|officers]] and [[Bureaucrat/Legends|bureaucrats]]. Teiras was in regular communication with the Alliance and was in charge of managing all movement along the pipeline. His cover was that of the story manager where his duties included dealing with shippers, sellers, dealers, and estates auction houses.
